release_readiness_note: Run841 is the latest fully successful GitHub-hosted Windows x64 and Windows Server 2022 lifecycle on tested source revision 05205ce11a103f1dd36b54aae81ff6d073550f77. It passed desktop/local-core/research tests, ESLint, TypeScript, packaged source-manifest and technical-schema verification, both NSIS x64 builds, clean install, external-network-blocked offline launch, SQLite backup/restore, in-place upgrade, integrity and uninstall while preserving the user database. The Windows Server 2022 lifecycle also passed. Main now contains post-run metadata-only additions to the central and Russian/EAEU source registers for an Armenian national OTTS public listing; no desktop application code changed, but these source-register changes have not yet been validated by a newer Windows/source-rights CI run. Regression coverage is proposed in PR #56, with no PR-triggered workflow run observed yet. Native Windows 10/11 x64 lifecycle remains skipped because the owner-provided isolated runner gate is disabled. Installers are unsigned because no owner-supplied code-signing certificate is configured. Rights-cleared Russian/EAEU OTTS, exact factory engine/gearbox/ECU applicability and licensed VAG repair content remain release blockers.
